verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly points to extensibility. Users can create and build their own flakes (nix flake new, nix build), install software over URLs, and point Nix at binary caches and remote builders. Together these suggest that package sources and build backends can be extended beyond the default nixpkgs set. Nothing documents consuming third-party package sets, overlays, or a plugin mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit docs on overlays or third-party flake/channel consumption, a plugin or backend extension interface, and independent corroboration of third-party ecosystem extension.
